reviewer_statement: Developer-scoped native R scientific Matplotlib input/artist-array geometry on supported FPCA source records. Direct frozen Python 1.2 plotting comparisons and three-OS CI are committed but not observed passing exact-head. No runtime Matplotlib Axes parity or independent scientific certification is asserted.
native_language_semantic_policy: Native FPCA source-scientific plot artist captures original numerical data, source-selected indices, source axis labels, artist settings and source uncertainty geometry. Rendering and exceptions belong to native R and cannot be equated to Matplotlib figures or full Python API return types.

case_evidence.description: Frozen Python 1.2 public src/eyetrajectoriespy/plotting.py::plot_fpca_influence. Source-scientific native strict mode is explicitly optional.

Native leave-one-group-out FPCA influence result class with original per-group source summary table, group labels and explicitly chosen complete numeric metric. User can choose any declared numeric influence summary column as in source; strict mode does not accept fabricated Python FPCAInfluenceResult or external Matplotlib axes.

Source line actual x=arange(number_of_groups) zero based, y=original declared metric in source group order, marker o, 90-degree original group tick labels, source axes and text. Frozen Python 1.2 public plot Matplotlib get_xdata/get_ydata, tick text and titles compared on precisely matching native scientific summary data; no inference on omissions is performed during drawing.

Native strict rejects wrong result class, missing/NA/Inf metric or group summary, nonlogical mode; source Python KeyError class and Matplotlib injected ax behavior are different, explicitly not claimed.

Source Python returns one Matplotlib Axes containing a line with marker o and source tick positions/text. Native strict returns typed source-scientific artist data with original x/y/labels/ticks and label rotation while drawing base R. R numeric group/value list remains unchanged in default mode.
Leave-one-group-out sensitivity of an already computed FPCA component measure to omission of each observed group. Display does not refit a model, recompute influence or alter source grouping.

independent_review_status: Developer source-scientific geometry review; exact-head native/Python test run not yet confirmed green, no independent reviewer signed off.
language_specific_limits: R base graphics device and typed R data cannot return Python Matplotlib Axes, artist object protocols, figure events or pixel-identical boxplots/errorbars.
No end-to-end bootstrap/random-replication parity is asserted beyond native scientific source arrays used as plotting inputs.
Python exception classes, dtype/protocol acceptance and optional ax injection remain outside bounded source geometry review.
Zero independent source-contract certification remains; no promise of merged branch or CRAN readiness.
